title: Resources, packaging, platform and release evidence
method: Enumerate every assigned legacy story including accepted ones; assert no unclassified task or source surface in the shard.
Trace installed UI/CLI/API entrypoint through actual services, policy, durable state and observable output; demonstrate disconnected code as a gap.
Run existing relevant tests and record actual counts, revisions and command evidence; a named obligation or source grep is not a passing test.
Exercise shard-specific errors, authorization denial without side effects, cancellation/restart and bounded resources in disposable fixtures.
Classify native V2, legacy compatibility, planned upstream and new scope; attach exact pin/path/symbol evidence and mandatory repair children for every gap.
